attr.title: Super Mario Galaxy
attr.desc: A native port of Super Mario Galaxy, built on Petari, SMGCommunity's decompilation of the game.
attr.inst: Copy your own RVZ image of Super Mario Galaxy (USA, revision 0, RMGE01) to the smg/gamefiles folder, next to the Super Mario Galaxy launcher in your ports folder. The first launch prepares the game files on the device, which takes a few minutes and about 3.5 GB of free space.
